instruction: When I play videos in VLC, the window keeps resizing automatically based on the video dimensions, which is annoying. Can you disable the automatic video window resizing feature?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC's automatic video window resizing. The evaluator checks if the 'qt-video-autoresize' setting in VLC configuration is set to 0 (disabled). This is similar to the original task which modifies VLC settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly reads the VLC configuration file (vlcrc) which contains the qt-video-autoresize setting
Metric function correctly parses the config file to extract the qt-video-autoresize value, defaulting to '1' (enabled) if not found
Metric correctly compares the extracted value against expected '0' (disabled) to verify the task completion
Expected value '0' semantically matches the instruction requirement to disable automatic video window resizing
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are saved and readable
Complete coverage: instruction only requires disabling autoresize, and evaluator checks exactly that requirement
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('expected_video_autoresize')
